issues.description: Constructor parameter order mismatch for class ExcellenceLand. The problem statement (UML and task description) requires the ExcellenceLand constructor to accept the class attributes in the order: (double excellencyLevel, boolean excellentEnough, List<Ride> rides). The solution implementation declares the constructor as public ExcellenceLand(List<Ride> rides, boolean excellentEnough, double excellencyLevel) — placing rides first and excellencyLevel last. This contradicts the required parameter order and will cause automated checks that verify constructor parameter ordering to fail and will confuse students about the required parameter sequence.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the ExcellenceLand constructor signature to accept parameters in the order required by the UML/task: public ExcellenceLand(double excellencyLevel, boolean excellentEnough, List<Ride> rides) { this.excellencyLevel = excellencyLevel; this.excellentEnough = excellentEnough; this.rides = rides; } Ensure the parameter order in the signature and the assignments follow the same sequence.
